description: Varuna — Maritime OT Posture. IACS UR E26/E27 compliance scoring, vessel protocol security assessment (Modbus/NMEA/AIS/GPS), continuous posture monitoring, and P&I-ready Posture Report Card. 5th sibling of the xShieldAI Posture Suite.
